tasks.label: sf: publish (RPM)
tasks.detail: one-liner: linux-arm64 self-contained publish plus the harbour RPM (opt out with -p:CreateSailfishRpm=false)

tasks.label: sf: set up device
tasks.detail: one-time: the phone's address, SSH user and developer-mode password (Settings > Developer tools > Remote connection) into ~/.config/maui-sailfish/connect.info, plus SSH key pairing; SailfishRun also asks on its first run

tasks.label: sf: run on device
tasks.detail: publish, install the RPM over SSH and launch with the device log streamed (SailfishRun target; device credentials from connect.info / $SF_CONNECT_INFO)

tasks.label: sf: preflight (Debug)
tasks.detail: blocking gate for F5 debug: needs SF_TOOLS_DIR pointing at a maui-sailfish checkout's tools/ (or the packaged tools dir in the NuGet cache)

tasks.label: sf: deploy & run (Debug)
tasks.detail: publish Debug under harbour-<dir>-debug, upload, install, launch, print the log tail. preLaunchTask of 'F5 DEBUG (deploy + attach)'.

tasks.label: sf: push vsdbg to device
tasks.detail: one-time setup for step 2/2: puts the linux-arm64 vsdbg in /tmp/vsdbg/ (never in the RPM), verifies it runs there, relaxes yama ptrace_scope if needed

tasks.label: sf: debug attach prep
tasks.detail: pushes vsdbg if needed and prints DEVICE_PID of the running Debug build for the '2/2 DEBUGGER attach (pid...)' configuration
